records.summary: Three child demonstrations are introduced; the hydrocephalus case is described with serial head measurements and only general light perception.
records.scope: selected English 1972 passages reviewed in context; paragraph located by topic cue in unnumbered RSP1972 layout
records.german_collation: two selected numerical and terminology comparisons only
records.editorial_caution: reported measurements and perceptions; no independent patient-record verification

records.paragraph: post-birth breathing, convulsions and developmental narrative
records.summary: The reported history includes respiratory transition, an early convulsion and progressive head enlargement; Steiner then posits difficulty of I and astral organization entering bodily members.
records.scope: selected English 1972 passages reviewed in context; paragraph located by topic cue in unnumbered RSP1972 layout
records.german_collation: two selected numerical and terminology comparisons only
records.editorial_caution: The medical observations and purported cause are different evidential categories

records.paragraph: mother's astral body and immature I interpretation
records.summary: Steiner interprets the child's condition through supposed resemblance to the mother's astral body and arrested prenatal I-organization.
records.scope: selected English 1972 passages reviewed in context; paragraph located by topic cue in unnumbered RSP1972 layout
records.german_collation: two selected numerical and terminology comparisons only
records.editorial_caution: Unverified metaphysical attribution; do not interpret as parental causation

records.paragraph: womb, cosmic head formation and metabolism-limbs
records.summary: The womb is said to shield head formation from earthly influences while cosmic forces dominate, in contrast to later metabolic-limb development.
records.scope: selected English 1972 passages reviewed in context; paragraph located by topic cue in unnumbered RSP1972 layout
records.german_collation: two selected numerical and terminology comparisons only
records.editorial_caution: Not modern embryology; quotation or diagram should carry attributed historical context

records.paragraph: maternal feeling and father's heart condition
records.summary: Steiner treats the father's heart illness and the mother's prenatal feelings as factors in an asserted head/limb hereditary imbalance.
records.scope: selected English 1972 passages reviewed in context; paragraph located by topic cue in unnumbered RSP1972 layout
records.german_collation: two selected numerical and terminology comparisons only
records.editorial_caution: No evidential support for blaming parents for hydrocephalus or disability; historically stigmatizing

records.paragraph: retained earlier developmental phase across stages
records.summary: The hydrocephalus case is used as an extreme illustrative model for the claim that earlier developmental stages may persist into later ones.
records.scope: selected English 1972 passages reviewed in context; paragraph located by topic cue in unnumbered RSP1972 layout
records.german_collation: two selected numerical and terminology comparisons only
records.editorial_caution: Do not generalize from a single historical case to children's developmental diagnoses

records.paragraph: second case: reported stealing and claimed consciousness isolation

records.german_collation: two selected numerical and terminology comparisons only
